newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRASTA STARTS BALTA SUBSCRIPTION JULY 7.
newsitem.headline: TRASTA STARTS BALTA SUBSCRIPTION JULY 7.

text.p: The subscribtion for Balta insurance company shares will last three weeks from July 7, Trasta Bank said on Wednesday.

"Trasta Bank is acting as the placing agent for the new issue of 200,000 shares or 6.5 percent of its stake and making what was a closed issue a public issue," Aldis Reims, deputy board chairman of Trasta, said at a news conference.
The price of each share, earlier set by Balta's shareholders, is 1.75 lats.
Trasta will determine the number of shares an investor will receive on August 4.

"If the demand exceeds the offer, Trasta will offer up to 30 shares to all those who applied and anything remaining above that would be distributed proportionally," Roberts Idelsons, head of Trasta's securities department, said.
August 15 is the payment deadline and by August 22 the shares will be transferred to the investors' accounts, Idelsons said.
